rationale: The user asked to reinstate a canceled order. The agent consistently explained that reinstating a canceled order is not possible due to system limitations, which aligns with typical retail policy and the provided summary that changes are only allowed when status rules permit. The agent did not perform any account-specific actions or share account data without authentication, so the lack of identity verification is acceptable. No writes were attempted without confirmation. The agent offered appropriate alternatives (place a new order) and, when the user refused, correctly offered and executed a handoff to a human agent. No fabricated tool results or unsupported claims were made. Thus, the agent handled the request within policy constraints and concluded with a proper escalation.
